retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, blue-toned portrait viewed through a rain-streaked glass pane with centered condensed typography.
excludeWhen: sharp, high-contrast facial features are needed
serif or decorative script fonts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A pale, ethereal face emerges from a misty, blue-tinted background, obscured by a foreground layer of water droplets on glass. The composition is dominated by soft, high-key lighting and a cool monochromatic palette, with a single line of condensed, lowercase text positioned in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject is layered behind a textured water-on-glass foreground
High-key facial highlights blend into the misty background
Typography is anchored horizontally across the forehead area of the subject
Cool blue tones unify the background and foreground textures
coreInvariants: Visible water droplets and condensation texture across the entire frame
Monochromatic or near-monochromatic blue color cast
High-key exposure that washes out facial details into white

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centrally located, filling approximately 60% of the frame vertically, appearing slightly out of focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject, though softened, serve as the primary focal point behind the water texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the sharp typography, moves down to the subject's eyes, and then follows the vertical streaks of the raindrops.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The edges of the frame consist of dense blue mist and water droplets, creating a vignette effect that pushes focus inward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Powder blue and sky blue provide the overall atmospheric tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white is used for the high-key highlights of the face and the secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow-gold is used for the primary name text to provide a subtle warm contrast.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with very high value (brightness), creating a washed-out, dreamy effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid deep blacks or high-contrast shadows
Limit palette to cool blues, whites, and one muted warm accent

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase only for a modern, soft feel

composition.overlap: placed over the subject's forehead area
composition.relationshipToImage: floating on the surface of the glass

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-based hierarchy to distinguish name from title.
graphicDevices: Color blocking within a single line of text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, narrow, and modern sans-serif aesthetic.
Similar width but would require significant weight reduction.
Provides the necessary verticality and condensed structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, soft-focus portrait of a woman with pale skin and light hair, tinted in a monochromatic powder blue. Overlay the entire image with a realistic texture of water droplets and condensation as if seen through a window pane.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the text in a single line using an extra-condensed sans-serif font in all lowercase. Position it in the upper center. Use a pale muted gold for the first half and white for the second half.

verificationChecks: Is the image dominated by a cool blue, high-key tone?
Are the water droplets sharp while the face is soft?

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of water texture and portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check that the face does not look 'pasted on' but emerges from the mist.
Ensure the water droplets vary in size and include some vertical streaks.
Verify the text is centered and uses the specified color split.
Confirm the overall mood is melancholic and ethereal.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key blue portrait + water-on-glass texture + centered condensed lowercase sans-serif.
